blind_spots: The exact forcing semantics is globally linear, so a naive local CA state may lose long-range cancellation information unless the quotient-module state is chosen carefully.
The product-grid parameterization could bias search toward certificate families that look regular and miss irregular low-score constructions.
Integer coefficients can grow quickly; bounded-coefficient local surrogates may silently exclude valid exact derivations.
Neural or evolutionary surrogates can optimize toward verifier-correlated proxies that still fail exact forcing on the final step.
The literature bridge is strong on local-update systems but thinner on automated theorem discovery specifically inside additive combinatorics.
A dedicated Semantic Scholar tool was not exposed in the environment, so citation branching relied on the existing manifest plus targeted web retrieval rather than fresh graph API calls.

anomaly_results.constraint: Restrict X to at most three nonzero slopes.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: The search likely collapses into overly affine or repetitive local dynamics and stalls before complete forcing.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: This tests whether score gains require richer alphabets or better reuse of a tiny alphabet.

anomaly_results.constraint: Require full permutation symmetry across all construction layers.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: Search becomes cheaper and may rediscover known motifs, but the symmetry may block the asymmetry needed for anti-diagonal isolation.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: Useful for separating genuine structural progress from accidental overfitting to asymmetric instances.

anomaly_results.constraint: Maximize infection time at fixed m(G)+|R|.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: Sparse slow cascades may outperform fast dense cascades on score if edge reuse is the hidden lever.

anomaly_results.constraint: Ban repeated slope labels on adjacent construction layers.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: This may improve diversity and rational complexity but could hurt controllability because the same local lemma cannot be reused.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: It probes whether repeated motifs are a bug or the main source of leverage.

anomaly_results.constraint: Allow stochastic tie-breaking in the surrogate CA but require deterministic final certificates.

anomaly_results.why_it_matters: Separates exploratory dynamics from verifiable certificate structure.
